prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.4*Z0*Z1 - 0.3*Z1*Z2 + 0.5*Z2*Z3 - 0.2*Z3*Z4. gamma = 0.5. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — every pair here is already adjacent on that line. Any correct implementation of the phase terms is accepted. No measurement.
